cards.name: razorpay-campaign-filtering
cards.description: Filter Razorpay payments by campaign using the 'notes.campaign' column, not a separate 'notes' table.
cards.claim: When filtering by campaign in razorpay_payments, use the column 'notes.campaign' directly. Do not treat 'notes' as a table or use dot notation that implies a join.

cards.name: donor-payment-source-selection
cards.description: Use 'razorpay_payments' for questions about captured online payments, not 't_80g_receipts_2025'.

trigger.question_regex: captured payment|gave twice|donors made more than one

cards.claim: For questions about 'captured payments' or donor payment frequency, query the 'razorpay_payments' table. Do not join with 't_80g_receipts_2025' unless specifically asked for 80G receipt details, as 'razorpay_payments' contains the transaction status and email directly.
